body:
username:- poisonousloki87
reason why i was kicked:- spawn blocking
banned by:- JustBudah (recently changed username to ImRagingFanGirl)
Hello Moderators, I believe this recent infractions is false for the following reasons.

First of all this is is my only infraction. I am quite aware of the rules being a new regular in comunity. 

I was making spawn arrow proof to stop people on bridges bow spamming and spawn killing. 

Even if I did do something wrong, I didn't even get a warning, and it says on the Punishment Guidelines that I should have either got a verbal, or warn. https://avicus.net/forums/09e2758fd

I would also like some evidence showing what I did was wrong as I was only helping my team.

Overall I strongly believe that this infraction should be removed and moderators should warn before punishing. 

if you would like any more information about the event. please contact either DCRaven or Avy69. as they were witnesses.

Kind Regards 
Dan
